clue.text: Composition almost put out without piano

indicators.note: almost means not quite all, so the final letter of the word is dropped
without in its old sense of outside, so one piece sits around the other

p is the musical abbreviation for piano, meaning softly

explanation.surface: A piece of music, nearly finished, is released without its piano part.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Without' here means outside, not lacking: the shortened OUS(t) goes around P. Like every answer and clue in this puzzle, it avoids the letter E.
explanation.definitionFit: Latin for a work, it is the standard term for a numbered musical piece by a composer.

explanation.definitionFit: It is a text written while deliberately excluding one letter of the alphabet throughout, as this whole puzzle does.
